name: Aisyah binti Rahman
bio:
Aisyah grew up around her father's small motorcycle repair shop in Kuala Lumpur, sparking an early fascination with engines and mechanics. After completing her vocational training in automotive engineering, she sought opportunities to apply her skills in motorsport, initially volunteering at local racing events before landing a role with a regional touring car team. Her meticulous approach and problem-solving abilities quickly earned her a reputation as a reliable and highly competent fabricator.

After several years honing her skills, Aisyah decided to broaden her horizons by seeking international experience. She joined VW Racing Brasil, drawn by their reputation for innovation and commitment to nurturing talent. She is known for her practical solutions to complex fabrication challenges, blending traditional techniques with modern technologies. Aisyah is also a natural mentor, readily sharing her knowledge with junior team members and fostering a collaborative environment.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Aisyah is of average height with a strong, capable build.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils to a perfect point before starting a new task.
Has a collection of miniature racing flags on her workbench.
Meticulously labels every component she fabricates.
